name: 知识图谱
description: 轻量本地知识图谱模块，在模块沙箱中记录 subject-relation-object 事实，支持查询、导入、删除和结构摘要。
description_en: Lightweight local ontology module. Stores subject-relation-object facts in the module sandbox with query, import, delete, and summary actions.

apis.name: addFact
apis.desc: 添加一个 subject-relation-object 事实，可附带类型、标签、置信度和来源
apis.desc_en: Add a subject-relation-object fact with optional type, tags, confidence, and source
paramDesc: 标签数组或逗号分隔字符串，可选
paramDesc_en: Optional tag array or comma-separated string

apis.name: queryFacts
apis.desc: 按关键词、主体、关系、客体或标签查询本地事实
apis.desc_en: Query local facts by keyword, subject, relation, object, or tag

apis.name: importFacts
apis.desc: 从多行文本批量导入事实，支持 A -> relation -> B 或 A | relation | B
apis.desc_en: Import facts from text lines in A -> relation -> B or A | relation | B format

apis.name: summarizeGraph
apis.desc: 统计本地知识图谱的事实数、常见关系、常见主体和标签分布
apis.desc_en: Summarize graph size, top relations, top subjects, and tag distribution

apis.name: deleteFact
apis.desc: 按事实 ID 删除一条记录

apis.name: clearGraph
apis.desc: 清空本地知识图谱，需要 confirm=true
apis.desc_en: Clear the local ontology, requires confirm=true

apis.name: openPage
apis.desc: 打开知识图谱界面并返回 _openModule 信号
apis.desc_en: Open Ontology UI and return _openModule signal
